name: Termination Execution Notice
response_html:
Membership Termination Notice

{{ (company or "Our Organization")|e }}

Dear {{ (member.first_name or "Member")|e }},

This letter serves as official notice that your membership with {{ (company or "Our Organization")|e }} has been terminated.

Termination Details:

Member ID: {{ member.name|e }}
Termination Type: {{ doc.termination_type|e }}
Effective Date: {{ termination_date|e }}
Reason: {{ doc.reason_for_termination|e }}

As of the effective date above, you no longer have access to member benefits, services, or facilities. Any outstanding obligations remain in effect.

{% if doc.termination_type == 'Voluntary' %}

We respect your decision to end your membership and thank you for your past participation. Should your circumstances change, you are welcome to reapply for membership in the future.

{% elif doc.termination_type == 'Expulsion' %}

Appeals Process: You have the right to appeal this decision within 30 days of this notice. Please refer to the association bylaws for the appeals procedure.

{% endif %}

Next Steps:

  • Return any association property in your possession
  • Your access to member systems has been revoked
  • Any automatic payments have been cancelled
    • {% if outstanding_amount %}
  • Outstanding balance of €{{ outstanding_amount|e }} must be settled
    • {% endif %}

If you have any questions regarding this termination or need to arrange the return of association property, please contact us.

{{ (company or "Our Organization")|e }}
{{ company_address|e }}

This is an official notice from the membership administration.
subject: Membership Termination Notice - {{ member.full_name|e }}
